integrity: The all-function criterion is proved from support changes under a one-unit transfer; the enumerator follows by exact inclusion-exclusion and is independently checked from the definition on bounded orders.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The lexicographic-product literature already provides broader minimum-parameter coverage on its product class, including balanced complete multipartite specializations.
Finite exhaustive verification through order nine is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed all-function enumerations.
title: Total weak Roman domination on complete multipartite graphs
